mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% per annum compresses the risk-free discount rate, reducing the cost of capital for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market tightness that increases consumer spending capacity, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production growth above 100 index and GDP growth exceeding 0.5% quarterly indicates robust economic expansion, accelerating corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 growth > 0.5%) occurs but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for dwellings, boosting construction sector growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 thousand units during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales levels above 450,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending momentum, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450,000 million dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% per annum signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 5.0%), labor market strength supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% and housing starts above 1150 thousand units indicate strong consumer purchasing power, accelerating retail sector growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and HOUST > 1150) occurs but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
